title: Start Where the Data Are: Statistical Priors for One-Step Generation on Manifolds
abstract: arXiv:2611.31856v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fast generation on manifolds is important for scientific applications such as protein design, yet existing one-step generators often produce spurious samples in low-density gaps between data modes. Our analysis highlights the mismatch between uniform noise and concentrated data, motivating a statistical prior that captures the data's coarse structure. We first estimate this prior by fitting mixtures of tangent-space Gaussians through geometry-aware moment matching. However, independent noise-data pairing can still connect different modes and weaken the benefit of the fitted prior. We therefore introduce posterior coupling, which samples a latent component conditioned on each data point and draws its paired noise from that component. To extend this approach to long torsion-angle chains, where full-covariance mixtures become costly, we use a hidden Markov prior to model sequential dependence with shared parameters. translated_title: 从数据所在之处出发：面向流形上一步生成的统计先验
translated_abstract: 流形上的快速生成对于蛋白质设计等科学应用十分重要，然而现有的一步生成器常常在数据模式之间的低密度间隙中产生虚假样本。我们的分析揭示了均匀噪声与集中分布的数据之间的不匹配，由此启发我们提出一种能够捕捉数据粗略结构的统计先验。我们首先通过几何感知的矩匹配方法拟合切空间高斯混合模型来估计该先验。然而，独立的噪声-数据配对仍可能连接不同的模式，从而削弱拟合先验带来的好处。为此，我们引入了后验耦合方法，即以每个数据点为条件采样一个潜在分量，并从该分量中抽取与之配对的噪声。为了将该方法推广到全协方差混合模型代价过高的长扭转角链场景，我们使用隐马尔可夫先验，通过共享参数来建模序列依赖关系。由此得到的框架……
tldr: 该论文提出基于切空间高斯混合先验与后验耦合（并借助隐马尔可夫先验处理长扭转角链）的一步生成框架，使采样从数据密集区域出发，避免在流形低密度间隙产生虚假样本，从而提升蛋白质设计等科学应用中的生成质量与效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a one-step generation framework on manifolds that starts from data-dense regions using tangent-space Gaussian mixture priors with posterior coupling (and a hidden Markov prior for long torsion-angle chains), eliminating spurious samples in low-density gaps for applications such as protein design.
